title: I Think You're Projecting...
body: You fit an OLS model with an intercept using a design matrix $$\mathbb{X}$$ with $$n$$ rows and $$p+1$$ columns. The bias (intercept) column is the first column of $$\mathbb{X}, $$ and the remaining columns correspond to the $$p$$ features in the model. Let $$Y$$ be the vector of true outcomes and $$\hat{Y}$$ be the OLS predictions.\n\nNote: $$\mathbf{1}$$ is a vector of length $$n$$ where all elements are $$1$$. Assume $$\mathbb{X}$$ is full column rank.
